verdict: Meta is delivering leads; Google spent $2,105 this period with zero returns.
narrative: In the last 28 days, all 32 leads came from Meta at $117.82 per lead — and lead volume rose 22% week over week. Google Ads ran $2,105.26 in spend over the same window and produced zero conversions; the data confirms this is not a slow stretch but a confirmed tracking or campaign issue, and that spend is being reviewed now. Separately, 32 leads arrived through your ads this period, but no consultations were booked — the intake process downstream of ad delivery is being addressed so leads are reaching you and getting followed up. Google Business Profile actions dropped sharply in the last few days of the window, though that data can run behind and is being monitored closely. Next period you should see Google resolved or reallocated, and the intake path tightened so incoming leads convert to booked consults.
